## Editorial Tiers
- Tier S (Score ≥ 60): Flagship ecosystem builders with deep books, proven volume, and top reward confidence (e.g., Hyperliquid, Lighter, Entropy).
- Tier A (Score 52–59): High-credibility venues with verified points or confirmed token allocation.
- Tier B (Score 44–51): Mid-stage programs with active farming rewards.
- Tier C / D (Score < 44): Early or speculative protocols.
- Tier POST: Launched tokens (Paradex, dYdX) — evaluated for active trading and funding yield.
